cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a present-day indoor bowling alley during a quiet practice hour — testing her legendary precision on a leisure game; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a private present-day sleeper-train compartment beside a large window — waking from a nap and reaching to close the window blind as the train enters a station; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — lying on her left side; a walled garden with a lotus pond — sitting on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — holds a small hand lantern low at her side
